description: This file defines a React component named UserProfileModal that renders a modal dialog displaying core profile information of a user, including name, email, department, and tenant ID. It manages focus trapping, accessibility, and animations for a responsive, accessible user profile modal.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Returns an array of focusable and visible elements within a given root element.

methods.name: trapTabKey
methods.description: Handles focus trapping within the modal by cycling focus between focusable elements when Tab or Shift+Tab is pressed.
